result.title: Answer Delivery Under a Shared Token Budget: An Audited Study of Stopping and Finalization
result.summary: An inference budget is useful only when the system delivers an answer within it. We study a fixed-budget policy combining first-valid-box stopping with a charged finalization cue. On 100 fresh, independently audited GSM8K test questions per model, it improves delivered endpoint accuracy over first-box stopping by 8.0 percentage points for Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and 7.0 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. A prelocked repeat on the same questions gives 7.0 and 10.0 points; neither seed shows a gross harm relative to first-box stopping. The point estimates of incremental physical-slot savings are below one percent. A finalization-only ablation separates cue recovery from stopping, and a fixed scalar reader tests extraction as an alternative explanation. The cue is prior art; the contribution is a component and readout analysis with charged injections and verified paths. Results cover two checkpoints, one task, one prompt family, and two fixed seed conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在固定 token 预算下研究「首个有效框即停止」加计费 finalization 提示的交付策略，在 GSM8K 上对两个模型各 100 题做审计式评测，报告端点准确率提升、增量物理槽位节省低于 1%，并以仅 finalization 消融和固定标量读出排除替代解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本推理的停止与预算计费研究，不直接涉及视觉状态；但其把「提示恢复」与「停止」分离的消融、以及停止时机对实际成本与交付结果的影响，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 收益与成本核算的设计线索。
